ayudaRecuadro: Drag the box to move it; drag the corner to resize it.
ayudaEncuadres: The crop positions: from each second on, a different framing. Tap one to jump to that moment.
ayudaAuto: Watches who's talking and builds the framing changes on its own. Then you fine-tune them.
ayudaNuevo: From this second ({seg} s), a new framing. It starts the same as the current one: move it afterwards.
arrastraSubtitulo: Drag to move the caption up or down
arrastraTamano: Drag sideways to make it bigger or smaller

barra.ayuda: Drag the edges to lengthen or shorten it. The buttons shift it by 5 s.
barra.inicioAntes: Move the start 5 s earlier (the clip gets longer)
barra.inicioDespues: Move the start 5 s later (the clip gets shorter)
barra.finalAntes: Move the end 5 s earlier (the clip gets shorter)
barra.finalDespues: Move the end 5 s later (the clip gets longer)
